name: FIFO Orderer
description: Preserves first-in-first-out ordering of records through a pipeline by assigning monotonic sequence numbers and reordering out-of-order arrivals before downstream emission. Guarantees per-key or global order depending on partitioning.
when_to_use: Downstream systems require strict order (e.g., financial ledgers)
Upstream may emit records out of order due to retries or parallelism
Replay or backfill must match live ordering
drawbacks: Adds latency to wait for late records
